policy: Only published, public norms that apply to the exact administration may be entered here, with a full citation. Never estimate or invent values. Process metrics are exploratory and never normed. Clinical-group references (groups.adhd, groups.autism) follow the same policy and are chart overlays only: they never produce z-scores or flags.

trail-making.note: No published norms apply to this digital administration (15 circles per part, fixed alternate layouts, finger/mouse input). Published child norms exist for the paper Trail Making Test, but a different item count, layout and input device make them inapplicable. Placeholder — add age-band values and citation once validated for this version.

go-no-go.note: No published norms apply to this Go/No-Go protocol (40 trials, 25% no-go, 500 ms stimulus, 1000–1500 ms ISI). Placeholder.

flanker.note: No published norms apply to this Flanker protocol (32 trials, fish stimuli, 3 s limit). Published norms for other flanker implementations are not transferable. Placeholder.

spatial-span.note: No published norms apply to this digital Corsi-style administration (on-screen 9-tile layout, 700/300 ms timing, touch input). Norms for the physical block-tapping board are not transferable. Placeholder.
